Assertions.Description: Every claim in the ledger: definitions, theorems, finite verifications, hypotheses and falsified attempts.

schema.name: Kind
schema.Description: Role of the claim in the research: Definition, Theorem, Known result, Finite check, Hypothesis, Bridge obligation or Prize problem.

schema.name: IntroducedInLoop
schema.Description: The Effortless loop that added this claim; empty for claims carried over from research v05.

schema.name: StatusGroup
schema.Description: Proved (definition, proved or rederived known), Checked (finite verification only), Falsified, Superseded or Open.

schema.name: PremiseCount
schema.Description: Direct premises this claim depends on.

schema.name: DependentCount
schema.Description: Claims that list this one as a direct premise.

schema.name: EvidenceCount
schema.Description: Evidence files linked to this claim.

schema.name: RevisionCount
schema.Description: Recorded status changes of this claim.

schema.name: DescendantCount
schema.Description: Claims that rest on this one, directly or transitively.

schema.name: Predicate
schema.Description: The modeled predicate this claim is about, if any.

schema.name: PredicateVerdict
schema.Description: The model's verdict on the predicate's bounded instances.

schema.name: PredicateIsFinitelyDecidable
schema.Description: 1 when the model can decide the full statement.

schema.name: IsModelLinked
schema.Description: 1 when the claim is tied to a modeled predicate.

schema.name: PredicateIsRefuted
schema.Description: 1 when a counterexample instance fails in the model.

schema.name: PredicateIsVerified
schema.Description: 1 when the model decides the statement true.

schema.name: EffectiveStatus
schema.Description: The status the ledger uses: FALSIFIED when the model holds a counterexample, FINITE_VERIFIED when the model decides an open or checked claim true, otherwise the reported status.

schema.name: IsModelDecided
schema.Description: 1 when the model, not a report, decides the status.

schema.name: IsModelContradicted
schema.Description: 1 when the report asserts the claim (proved, checked or definitional) and the model refutes it: the report is wrong. An OPEN claim the model refutes is decided, not contradicted.

schema.name: ModelVerdict
schema.Description: The model's verdict on the claim's predicate; NOT MODELED for a claim stated only in words.

Dependencies.Description: Declared one-step logical dependencies between assertions.

schema.name: Conclusion
schema.Description: The assertion that depends on the premise.

schema.name: Premise
schema.Description: The assertion the conclusion relies on.

Prerequisites.Description: Transitive closure of Dependencies, one row per (conclusion, ancestor), regenerated by research/loop_tools.py.

schema.name: ConclusionKey
schema.Description: The assessment this transitive premise feeds.

schema.name: Premise
schema.Description: A transitive ancestor of the conclusion (including itself).

schema.name: IsSelf
schema.Description: 1 for the row pairing a claim with itself.

schema.name: IsBlockingAncestor
schema.Description: 1 when this ancestor is not usable and so blocks the conclusion.

Assessments.Description: Compiled status of each assertion given the status of all its ancestors.

schema.name: Statement
schema.Description: The claim being assessed, in words.

schema.name: StatusGroup
schema.Description: Proved, Checked, Falsified, Superseded or Open, from the reported status.

schema.name: SelfUsable
schema.Description: 1 when the claim itself is usable as a premise.

schema.name: CurrentStatus
schema.Description: BLOCKED when an ancestor is not usable, otherwise the effective status.

schema.name: SupportCount
schema.Description: Number of evidence files linked to this assertion.

schema.name: EvidenceGap
schema.Description: 1 for a reported finite verification with no evidence file; a model-decided one is its own evidence.

schema.name: AncestorBlockedCount
schema.Description: Ancestors (not counting the claim itself) that are not usable.

schema.name: IsAtRisk
schema.Description: 1 when a claim reported as established rests on an ancestor that is open, falsified or superseded. Should always be 0.

schema.name: AncestorCount
schema.Description: Claims this one rests on, directly or transitively.

schema.name: ProjectKey
schema.Description: Dashboard this assessment rolls up to.

schema.name: EffectiveStatus
schema.Description: The status the ledger uses (model-decided where it can be).

schema.name: IsModelDecided
schema.Description: 1 when the model decides the status.

Evidence.Description: Files produced by experiments, with sha256 hashes computed from disk.

schema.name: ClaimCount
schema.Description: Cell values this evidence file claims.

schema.name: ClaimMismatchCount
schema.Description: Claimed values the model computes differently. Must be 0.

Revisions.Description: Every status change, with the prior status kept visible.

schema.name: Replacement
schema.Description: Claim that replaces a falsified one, if any.

schema.name: Loop
schema.Description: The Effortless loop that made this change; empty for v05 revisions recorded before native loops.

Loops.Description: Research loops. Only Kind EFFORTLESS + State VERIFIED rows carry build receipts and hashes.

schema.name: Sequence
schema.Description: Order of the loop across legacy and native loops (legacy 1-13, then native).

schema.name: StartedAt
schema.Description: ISO time the loop started; recorded from the native loops after effortless-5.

schema.name: FinishedAt
schema.Description: ISO time the loop was verified.

schema.name: ProofsMade
schema.Description: Claims this loop moved to proved.

schema.name: ProjectKey
schema.Description: Dashboard this loop rolls up to.

schema.name: Hypothesis
schema.Description: The hypothesis this loop tested, as stated before the experiment.

schema.name: Summary
schema.Description: What the loop changed in the hub and what the build showed.

schema.name: EvidenceGapCount
schema.Description: Finite-verified claims with no linked evidence.

schema.name: CheckedCount
schema.Description: Claims verified by finite computation only.

schema.name: AtRiskCount
schema.Description: Established claims resting on something not established. Should be 0.

schema.name: LegacyLoopCount
schema.Description: Research cycles from v05, before native builds.

schema.name: ConformanceMismatchCount
schema.Description: Optimizer claims the model disagrees with. Must be 0.

schema.name: PredicatesFailingAnInstance
schema.Description: Predicates with at least one failing bounded instance.

schema.name: ModelLinkedClaimCount
schema.Description: Claims tied to a modeled predicate.

schema.name: ModelDecidedClaimCount
schema.Description: Claims whose status the model decides.

schema.name: ModelContradictionCount
schema.Description: Claims the model refutes although their report does not. Must be 0.

schema.name: UnmodeledClaimCount
schema.Description: Claims still only stated in words.

EvidenceLinks.Description: Which evidence file supports which assertion. One row per (evidence, assertion) pair.

schema.name: EvidencePath
schema.Description: Repo-relative path of the evidence file.

CellStates.Description: The two states a cell can hold, with their colors. Problem 2 asks whether each occurs equally often.

Rules.Description: Elementary cellular-automaton rules, as data. Rule 30 and the rest of its equivalence class (mirror 86, complement 135, both 149); each rule's table, symmetries and permutivity are computed from its RuleTableEntries.

schema.name: RuleNumber
schema.Description: Wolfram rule number 0..255: the output for neighborhood n is bit n.

schema.name: TableNumber
schema.Description: The rule number read back from the 8 computed transitions; equals RuleNumber when the table is consistent.

schema.name: BlackOutputCount
schema.Description: How many of the 8 neighborhoods output black.

schema.name: IsBalanced
schema.Description: 1 when exactly half the neighborhoods output black (a precondition for density 1/2 heuristics).

schema.name: IsQuiescent
schema.Description: 1 when 000 stays white, so a white background stays white and the light cone is exact.

schema.name: MirrorRuleNumber
schema.Description: The rule with left and right swapped (30 -> 86).

schema.name: ComplementRuleNumber
schema.Description: The rule with black and white swapped in inputs and output (30 -> 135).

schema.name: IsMirrorSymmetric
schema.Description: 1 when the rule is its own mirror.

schema.name: PolynomialMismatchCount
schema.Description: Neighborhoods where the rule differs from Mod[p + q + r + q r, 2].

schema.name: IsRule30Polynomial
schema.Description: 1 when the rule is exactly Wolfram's polynomial form of Rule 30.

schema.name: LeftInsensitiveCount
schema.Description: Pairs of neighborhoods differing only in the left cell that give the same output.

schema.name: IsLeftPermutive
schema.Description: 1 when flipping the left neighbor always flips the output (Rule 30: new = left XOR f(center, right)).

schema.name: RightInsensitiveCount
schema.Description: Pairs of neighborhoods differing only in the right cell that give the same output.

schema.name: IsRightPermutive
schema.Description: 1 when flipping the right neighbor always flips the output.

Neighborhoods.Description: The 8 neighborhoods a new cell is computed from: the cell and its immediate neighbors (left, center, right). Index = left*4 + center*2 + right selects the bit of the rule number.

schema.name: MirrorIndex
schema.Description: Index of the left-right reflected neighborhood.

schema.name: PolynomialValue
schema.Description: Wolfram's Rule 30 polynomial Mod[p + q + r + q r, 2] at this neighborhood.

schema.name: EntryCount
schema.Description: Rule tables that list this neighborhood.

RuleTableEntries.Description: One transition of one rule: neighborhood -> output value. The rule table is computed from the rule number; symmetries and permutivity are read off the table.

schema.name: Rule
schema.Description: The rule this transition belongs to.

schema.name: LeftPartner
schema.Description: Set when the left cell is white: the same rule with the left cell black. (One direction only, so the row graph stays acyclic.)

schema.name: RightPartner
schema.Description: Set when the right cell is white: the same rule with the right cell black.

schema.name: LeftState
schema.Description: The left cell of the neighborhood.

schema.name: RightState
schema.Description: The right cell of the neighborhood.

schema.name: NeighborhoodIndex
schema.Description: Which bit of the rule number this is.

schema.name: PolynomialValue
schema.Description: The Rule 30 polynomial at this neighborhood.

schema.name: OutputValue
schema.Description: The new cell state: bit NeighborhoodIndex of the rule number.

schema.name: Weight
schema.Description: This transition's contribution to the rule number.

schema.name: MirrorWeight
schema.Description: This transition's contribution to the mirror rule's number.

schema.name: ComplementWeight
schema.Description: This transition's contribution to the complement rule's number.

schema.name: MatchesPolynomial
schema.Description: 1 when the output equals Mod[p + q + r + q r, 2].

schema.name: LeftPartnerOutput
schema.Description: Output with the left cell flipped.

schema.name: IsLeftSensitive
schema.Description: On rows with a left partner: 1 when flipping the left cell flips the output.

schema.name: RightPartnerOutput
schema.Description: Output with the right cell flipped.

schema.name: IsRightSensitive
schema.Description: On rows with a right partner: 1 when flipping the right cell flips the output.

schema.name: UseCount
schema.Description: How many cells of the runs were produced by this transition.

InitialConditions.Description: The states of all cells at time 0: a background color plus the listed seed cells.

schema.name: Background
schema.Description: The state of every cell not listed as a seed cell.

schema.name: IsSingleSeed
schema.Description: 1 for the prize problems' initial condition: one nonzero cell (black) at position 0 on white.

SeedCells.Description: A cell of an initial condition that differs from (or is stated beside) the background.

schema.name: InitialCondition
schema.Description: The initial condition this cell belongs to.

schema.name: Position
schema.Description: Position i of the seed cell.

Runs.Description: One evolution: a rule applied to an initial condition up to a depth. The prize problems are about the run of Rule 30 from the single seed.

schema.name: Rule
schema.Description: The rule applied at every time step.

schema.name: Depth
schema.Description: The last time step computed: the horizon.

schema.name: IsLightConeExact
schema.Description: 1 when every cell outside |i| <= t is white, so computing only the cone is exact.

schema.name: IsPrizeSetup
schema.Description: 1 for the prize problems' setup: Rule 30 from the single seed.

schema.name: TotalCellUpdates
schema.Description: Cell updates needed to reach the depth.

schema.name: CenterLength
schema.Description: Terms of the center column computed: c(0) .. c(Depth).

schema.name: CenterOnes
schema.Description: Black terms in the center column.

schema.name: CenterDensity
schema.Description: Share of black in the computed center column.

schema.name: CenterDiscrepancy
schema.Description: Ones minus zeros in the computed center column.

schema.name: MaxAbsCenterDiscrepancy
schema.Description: Largest |ones - zeros| over all center prefixes.

schema.name: LongestCenterRun
schema.Description: Longest constant run in the center column.

schema.name: CenterRunBoundViolations
schema.Description: Center cells past the Theorem D bound for their run. Must be 0.

TimeSteps.Description: One line of a run: time step t. Width, black count and the center term are aggregated from its cells; cell updates accumulate along the time chain.

schema.name: PreviousStep
schema.Description: Time step t - 1; empty at t = 0.

schema.name: Width
schema.Description: Cells in the light cone at this time step.

schema.name: CellCount
schema.Description: Cells computed at this time step; equals Width.

schema.name: LineDensity
schema.Description: Share of black on this line.

schema.name: CellUpdates
schema.Description: Cells the rule computes to produce this line (none at t = 0).

schema.name: CumulativeCellUpdates
schema.Description: Cell updates needed to reach this line: (t + 1)^2 - 1.

Columns.Description: The cells at one position over time, read as a sequence in t. The center column (position 0) is the sequence of center-cell values all three problems are about.

schema.name: FirstTime
schema.Description: First time step at which the light cone reaches this column; earlier terms are background.

schema.name: Density
schema.Description: Share of black among terms 0 .. Depth (background terms count as white).

Cells.Description: x(i, t): one cell of a run, inside the light cone |i| <= t <= 64. Its value is the seed at t = 0, otherwise the rule-table output selected by its three parents. Along the column (CenterParent is the previous term) it accumulates the Problem 2 prefix counts and the Problem 1 constant runs.

schema.name: TimeStep
schema.Description: The line (time step) this cell is on.

schema.name: Column
schema.Description: The column (position) this cell is in.

schema.name: SeedCell
schema.Description: At t = 0: the seed cell listed at this position, if any.

schema.name: LeftParent
schema.Description: Cell (t-1, i-1); empty outside the cone.

schema.name: CenterParent
schema.Description: Cell (t-1, i): the previous term of this column; empty outside the cone.

schema.name: RightParent
schema.Description: Cell (t-1, i+1); empty outside the cone.

schema.name: RuleNumber
schema.Description: The rule number of the run.

schema.name: BackgroundValue
schema.Description: The background state of the run.

schema.name: SeedValue
schema.Description: State of the seed cell here, if listed.

schema.name: LeftValue
schema.Description: Value of the left parent (blank outside the cone).

schema.name: CenterValue
schema.Description: Value of the center parent: the previous term of this column.

schema.name: Neighborhood
schema.Description: Index of the parents' neighborhood; a blank parent is white (exact when the run is light-cone exact).

schema.name: TransitionKey
schema.Description: The RuleTableEntry that produced this cell; blank at t = 0.

schema.name: Value
schema.Description: The cell: the initial condition at t = 0, otherwise bit Neighborhood of the rule number.

schema.name: IsCenter
schema.Description: 1 on the center column c(t) = x(0, t).

schema.name: IsColumnStart
schema.Description: 1 on the first computed cell of its column; earlier terms are background.

schema.name: RightOffset
schema.Description: k of the right-edge diagonal y_k(t) = x(t-k, t) this cell lies on.

schema.name: LeftOffset
schema.Description: k of the left-edge diagonal w_k(t) = x(-t+k, t) this cell lies on.

schema.name: PriorColumnOnes
schema.Description: Black terms of this column through t - 1.

schema.name: ColumnOnes
schema.Description: Black terms of this column in the prefix 0 .. t (background terms are white).

schema.name: ColumnDensity
schema.Description: Share of black in the prefix: the running average of Problem 2.

schema.name: Discrepancy
schema.Description: Ones minus zeros in the prefix.

schema.name: DensityDeviation
schema.Description: Distance of the running density from 1/2.

schema.name: PriorRunStart
schema.Description: Start of the constant run the previous term belongs to.

schema.name: RunStart
schema.Description: First time step of the constant run this term belongs to. (Equality is written as a difference: rulebook-to-postgres mistypes field = field inside a self-referencing chain, docs/toolchain-gaps.md gap 7.)

schema.name: RunLength
schema.Description: Length of the constant run so far.

schema.name: RunBound
schema.Description: Theorem D, the center-run bounds: a black run starting at T ends by 2T+1, a white one by 4T+5.

schema.name: ViolatesRunBound
schema.Description: 1 when this center term lies past the Theorem D bound of its run.

schema.name: RunBoundHolds
schema.Description: Theorem D instance: 1 when this term respects the bound.

schema.name: ClaimCount
schema.Description: Accelerator claims made about this cell.

Periods.Description: Candidate periods p >= 1 for Problem 1 (bounded at 24 in the model; unbounded in the problem).

PeriodTests.Description: Is this column eventually periodic with this period? A summary of its PeriodicityCandidates: every onset up to the last mismatch is refuted; later onsets survive only because the horizon ends.

schema.name: LastOnset
schema.Description: The last onset T whose comparison c(T) vs c(T + p) is inside the horizon.

schema.name: ComparisonCount
schema.Description: Comparisons x(i, t) vs x(i, t + p) inside the horizon.

schema.name: LastMismatchTime
schema.Description: The last t with x(i, t + p) != x(i, t). Every onset T <= it is refuted.

schema.name: LongestAgreementStreak
schema.Description: Longest stretch on which the column looked p-periodic.

schema.name: RefutedCandidateCount
schema.Description: Onsets with a witness inside the horizon.

schema.name: FirstSurvivingOnset
schema.Description: The first onset the horizon cannot refute.

schema.name: FinalAgreementLength
schema.Description: Matching comparisons after the last mismatch, up to the horizon.

schema.name: OnsetBound
schema.Description: Bounded form of Problem 1: every onset up to this must be refuted.

schema.name: BoundedRefutationHolds
schema.Description: 1 when every onset T <= OnsetBound has a mismatch at some t >= T.

schema.name: WindowCount
schema.Description: Theorem C windows for this period that end inside the horizon.

schema.name: WindowFailureCount
schema.Description: Windows with no mismatch in either column. Theorem C says 0.

schema.name: CenterWitnessWindowCount
schema.Description: Windows where column 0 alone has the mismatch.

schema.name: WindowsHold
schema.Description: 1 when every Theorem C window of this period holds.

PeriodicityCandidates.Description: The hypothesis 'column i is periodic with period p from onset T' (Problem 1 quantifies over these (p, T)). Each row is also the comparison x(i, T) vs x(i, T + p); the chain to T + 1 finds the first mismatch at or after T: the witness that refutes the candidate.

schema.name: EarlierCell
schema.Description: x(i, T); empty before the light cone reaches the column (white).

schema.name: NextCandidate
schema.Description: The candidate with onset T + 1; empty at the last onset.

schema.name: OnsetBound
schema.Description: Largest onset in the bounded form of Problem 1.

schema.name: EarlierBit
schema.Description: x(i, T), white outside the cone.

schema.name: IsMismatch
schema.Description: 1 when x(i, T + p) != x(i, T).

schema.name: NextFirstMismatch
schema.Description: Witness of the candidate with onset T + 1.

schema.name: FirstMismatchFrom
schema.Description: The witness: the first t >= T with x(i, t + p) != x(i, t); LastOnset + 1 when there is none inside the horizon.

schema.name: IsRefuted
schema.Description: 1 when the horizon holds a witness against this candidate.

schema.name: AgreementRunFrom
schema.Description: Consecutive matching comparisons starting at T.

schema.name: InBoundedDomain
schema.Description: 1 when the onset is in the bounded form of Problem 1 (T <= (depth - p)/2).

MismatchWindows.Description: Theorem C for one (T, p): some i in {0, 1} and t in [T, 2T + p] have x(i, t) != x(i, t + p). Only windows that end inside the horizon are rows.

schema.name: CenterTest
schema.Description: The center column test for p (for the roll-up).

schema.name: CenterCandidate
schema.Description: Column 0 with period p from onset T.

schema.name: NeighborCandidate
schema.Description: Column 1 with period p from onset T.

schema.name: CenterWitness
schema.Description: First mismatch at or after T in column 0.

schema.name: NeighborWitness
schema.Description: First mismatch at or after T in column 1.

schema.name: CenterInWindow
schema.Description: 1 when column 0 alone has a mismatch in the window (Theorem C does not promise this).

schema.name: NeighborInWindow
schema.Description: 1 when column 1 has a mismatch in the window.

schema.name: WindowHolds
schema.Description: Theorem C instance: 1 when column 0 or column 1 has a mismatch in [T, 2T + p].

LeftConsistencyChecks.Description: TX at one time step of the real center: when c(t) = 1 the rule at column 0 forces c(t + 1) = NOT x(-1, t), so the center is decided by its own past through the left half. After a 0 the left half says nothing.

schema.name: LeftBit
schema.Description: x(-1, t), white outside the cone.

schema.name: IsOneTime
schema.Description: 1 when c(t) = 1, the times at which the left half decides the next term.

schema.name: ForcedNext
schema.Description: The value NOT x(-1, t) the left half forces at a one-time.

schema.name: IsConsistent
schema.Description: TX instance: 1 unless c(t) = 1 and c(t + 1) != NOT x(-1, t).

PeriodicWords.Description: A finite word a; the tail a a a ... is what an eventually periodic center would repeat. Its least period, constancy and B9 membership are computed from its letters.

schema.name: IsNonconstant
schema.Description: 1 when the word has both colors.

schema.name: LeastPeriod
schema.Description: Smallest d >= 1 with a rotated by d equal to a (d = |a| always qualifies).

schema.name: IsPrimitive
schema.Description: 1 when the least period is the full length.

schema.name: IsInB9Domain
schema.Description: 1 for a nonconstant word of least period |a|: the tails B9 excludes.

schema.name: TailCandidateCount
schema.Description: Onsets this tail is spliced on at.

schema.name: KilledCandidateCount
schema.Description: Of those, the ones left-consistency kills inside the horizon.

schema.name: KilledExcessMax
schema.Description: Raw MAXIFS; over an empty set it is blank in compile-rulebook and 0 in Postgres (docs/toolchain-gaps.md gap 12), so read MaxKillExcess.

schema.name: MaxKillExcess
schema.Description: Longest a killed tail survived past its onset; -2 when no candidate of this word was killed (or none exists).

WordLetters.Description: One letter a[k] of a word.

WordShifts.Description: A rotation of a word by d positions; a symmetry when every letter matches its rotated partner.

schema.name: MismatchCount
schema.Description: Letters with a[k] != a[(k + d) mod |a|].

schema.name: IsSymmetry
schema.Description: 1 when rotating by d leaves the word unchanged.

WordShiftChecks.Description: One letter against its rotated partner: a[k] vs a[(k + d) mod |a|].

TailCandidates.Description: The real center up to onset T, then the tail a a a ... from T: the center an eventual a-periodicity from T would have. TX says the real center is left-consistent; B9 says no left-consistent sequence ends in a nonconstant periodic tail, so every candidate must fail a one-time check. The kill uses only the real prefix and the rule, never the real center after T.

schema.name: Run
schema.Description: The run whose prefix is used.

schema.name: Onset
schema.Description: T: the first time step of the tail.

schema.name: KillTime
schema.Description: The witness: the first one-time t >= T - 1 at which c(t + 1) != NOT x(-1, t); Horizon + 1 when none.

schema.name: IsKilled
schema.Description: 1 when left-consistency kills the tail inside the horizon.

schema.name: KillExcess
schema.Description: How long past the onset the tail survived (-1: killed by the first tail bit).

schema.name: CellCount
schema.Description: Left-half cells computed for this tail.

TailCenterTerms.Description: c'(t) of a tail candidate: the real center before the onset, the tail word's letter a[(t - T) mod |a|] from it.

schema.name: Letter
schema.Description: From the onset: the letter a[(t - T) mod |a|].

TailCells.Description: x'(i, t), i <= -1, of a tail candidate: the left half driven by c'. At the onset it equals the real left half (TX: the left half depends only on the center's past); after it, Rule 30 with c' as the right boundary. Only cells that can reach x'(-1, t) by the horizon are rows.

schema.name: RealCell
schema.Description: At the onset: the real cell x(i, T).

schema.name: LeftParent
schema.Description: x'(i - 1, t - 1); empty outside the cone (white).

schema.name: CenterTerm
schema.Description: c'(t - 1), the right parent of column -1.

schema.name: Neighborhood
schema.Description: Index of the parents' neighborhood; the right parent of column -1 is the candidate center.

TailChecks.Description: The one-time check at t of a tail candidate: when c'(t) = 1, left-consistency requires c'(t + 1) = NOT x'(-1, t). The chain to t + 1 finds the first violation: the kill.

schema.name: RealLeftCell
schema.Description: Before the onset: x(-1, t) (empty at t = 0, white).

schema.name: NextCheck
schema.Description: The check at t + 1; empty at the horizon.

schema.name: IsViolation
schema.Description: 1 when c'(t) = 1 and c'(t + 1) != NOT x'(-1, t): the tail is not left-consistent.

schema.name: FirstViolationFrom
schema.Description: First violating time >= t; Horizon + 1 when none.

Diagonals.Description: A diagonal of the cone read as a sequence in t: right side y_k(t) = x(t - k, t), left side w_k(t) = x(k - t, t) (k = 0 is the edge). Before the cone reaches it a diagonal is white.

schema.name: PreviousDiagonal
schema.Description: The diagonal k - 1 on the same side; empty at k = 0.

schema.name: OppositeDiagonal
schema.Description: For a left diagonal w_k: the right diagonal y_k (one direction only).

schema.name: RightOnes
schema.Description: Black cells with t - i = k.

schema.name: LeftOnes
schema.Description: Black cells with t + i = k.

schema.name: OnesCount
schema.Description: Black cells on the diagonal inside the horizon.

schema.name: CellCount
schema.Description: Cells of the diagonal inside the cone and the horizon.

schema.name: FirstOneTime
schema.Description: First t with a black cell on the diagonal; -1 when none inside the horizon.

schema.name: PureCount
schema.Description: Dyadic periods the whole observed diagonal has.

schema.name: LeastPeriod
schema.Description: P_k: the least dyadic period of the diagonal from t = 0; -1 when none is certified inside the horizon.

schema.name: EventualCount
schema.Description: Dyadic periods the diagonal eventually has.

schema.name: EventualPeriod
schema.Description: Least dyadic eventual period; -1 when none is certified inside the horizon.

schema.name: EventualOnset
schema.Description: Onset of the least eventual period.

schema.name: OnesPerPeriod
schema.Description: Black cells in one least period y_k(0 .. P_k - 1).

schema.name: OppositeLeastPeriod
schema.Description: P_k of the right diagonal with the same offset.

DiagonalPeriodTests.Description: Is the dyadic d a period of the diagonal, from t = 0 (pure) or from some onset (eventual)?

schema.name: HalfCell
schema.Description: The cell of the diagonal at t = d / 2 (empty before the cone: white).

schema.name: HalfValue
schema.Description: The diagonal at d / 2, white before the cone.

schema.name: IsPurePeriod
schema.Description: 1 when every comparison matches and every residue mod d is compared at least once.

schema.name: EventualOnset
schema.Description: The first t from which every comparison matches.

schema.name: IsEventualPeriod
schema.Description: 1 when d is a period from the onset on, with the onset in the first half of the horizon and at least 2d matching comparisons after it.

DiagonalPeriodChecks.Description: One comparison of a diagonal period test: the diagonal at t against t + d.

schema.name: EarlierCell
schema.Description: The diagonal at t (empty before the cone: white).

schema.name: EarlierBit
schema.Description: At t, white before the cone.

schema.name: LaterBit
schema.Description: At t + d, white before the cone.

schema.name: IsMismatch
schema.Description: 1 when the diagonal differs at t and t + d.

DiagonalFacts.Description: One fact a predicate states about one diagonal, decided from the diagonal's computed periods and cells.

schema.name: Fact
schema.Description: Which fact: all-ones: every cone cell on the edge is black; first-one-at-half: first black cell at t = ceil(k/2), and P_k exceeds that time; balanced: exactly half the cells of one least period are black; doubles: P_k = 2 P_{k-1}; nondecreasing: P_k >= P_{k-1}; repeat-or-double: P_k is P_{k-1} or 2 P_{k-1}; no-triple-double: not (eps_k = eps_{k-1} = eps_{k-2} = 1); half-period-one: y_k(P_k / 2) = 1; eventually-dyadic: w_k has a dyadic eventual period <= min(2^k, 8) inside the horizon; parity-after-doubling: if eps_{k-1} = 1 then eps_k = ones of y_{k-2} per period mod 2; parity-always: eps_k = ones of y_{k-2} per period mod 2; left-half-speed: Pw_k^2 <= P_k (log2 Pw_k <= log2 P_k / 2).

schema.name: OppositeLeastPeriod
schema.Description: P_k of the right diagonal with the same offset.

schema.name: Holds
schema.Description: 1 when the fact holds for this diagonal.

schema.name: IsDecided
schema.Description: 1 when the horizon certifies the periods the fact needs; otherwise the fact is not an instance.

Tolerances.Description: Margins epsilon around 1/2 for Problem 2. The limit is 1/2 exactly when, for every epsilon, excursions eventually stop.

schema.name: EpsilonDenominator
schema.Description: Denominator of the margin. Exact integers, because a float margin and a NUMERIC margin disagree at exact boundaries (docs/toolchain-gaps.md gap 9).

schema.name: ExcursionCount
schema.Description: Prefixes whose density is more than epsilon from 1/2.

schema.name: LastExcursionTime
schema.Description: The witness: the last prefix end t outside the margin.

schema.name: SettledAtHorizon
schema.Description: Problem 2 instance: 1 when the density at the horizon is within epsilon of 1/2.

ToleranceChecks.Description: One prefix of the center column against one tolerance: is its density within epsilon of 1/2?

schema.name: Cell
schema.Description: The center cell ending the prefix.

schema.name: IsExcursion
schema.Description: 1 when the prefix density is more than epsilon from 1/2, in exact integers: |ones - zeros| / N > 2 epsilon.

ColorCounts.Description: How often each color occurs in each column ("does each color of cell occur on average equally often").

schema.name: ConeCount
schema.Description: Computed cells of this column with this color.

schema.name: OccurrenceCount
schema.Description: Terms 0 .. Depth of this column with this color, counting background terms as white.

schema.name: Share
schema.Description: Share of terms with this color.

MachineModels.Description: What one step of computational effort is: the cost model. Problem 3 needs one fixed; universality relates them only up to simulation overhead.

schema.name: StepMeaning
schema.Description: What one unit of effort counts.

schema.name: InputEncoding
schema.Description: How n is given to the machine.

Algorithms.Description: A way of computing c(n) on a machine model. An algorithm that stores the answer is not admissible. Problem 3 asks whether every admissible algorithm's effort ratio effort/n is unbounded. Light-cone simulation costs O(n²) cell updates; beating O(n²) would be a partial result.

schema.name: MachineModel
schema.Description: The machine model its effort is counted in.

schema.name: EffortRule
schema.Description: How its effort for n is counted: cone-updates (simulate the light cone) or table-read (one read).

schema.name: StoresAnswer
schema.Description: 1 when the machine contains the sequence itself.

schema.name: IsAdmissible
schema.Description: 1 when the algorithm does not store the answer.

schema.name: WrongOutputCount
schema.Description: Outputs that differ from c(n). Must be 0.

schema.name: IsRatioGrowing
schema.Description: 1 when effort/n grows between half the horizon and the horizon (no sign of O(n)).

schema.name: EffortHolds
schema.Description: Problem 3 instance: an admissible algorithm shows no sign of O(n) effort (inadmissible ones are excluded, so hold vacuously).

Computations.Description: machine[m][n] = {v, t}: one algorithm computing c(n), with its output value and effort.

schema.name: ConeUpdates
schema.Description: Cell updates to reach line n.

schema.name: OutputValue
schema.Description: v: the value the algorithm outputs (both recorded algorithms read the computed cell).

Variables.Description: The variables the predicates quantify over, the table whose rows are their values in the model, and whether their domain is infinite in the problem.

schema.name: DomainTable
schema.Description: The table whose rows are its values in the model (finite there).

schema.name: IsUnboundedInProblem
schema.Description: 1 when its domain in the problem is infinite.

schema.name: BinderCount
schema.Description: Quantifiers binding it, across all predicates.

Operators.Description: The symbols formal statements are built from: binders (quantifiers, limits), connectives, relations, arithmetic and the functions of the model (c, x, rule30, cTail, ...).

schema.name: Kind
schema.Description: binder, infix, prefix, apply, atom, var or const: how a term with this operator is written out.

schema.name: Arity
schema.Description: Number of arguments (a binder has two: its condition and its body).

schema.name: IsModeled
schema.Description: 1 when the model computes this operator (a table or field gives it its value); 0 when it is only a named symbol so far.

Terms.Description: One node of a formal statement: an operator with its argument terms, a variable, or a constant. A binder holds its bound variable, its condition (Arg1) and its body (Arg2). The text, the quantifier count and whether a quantifier ranges over an infinite domain are computed from the tree.

schema.name: TermOperator
schema.Description: The operator (var and const for leaves).

schema.name: Variable
schema.Description: The variable of a var leaf, or the variable a binder binds.

schema.name: Constant
schema.Description: The value of a const leaf.

schema.name: BoundsVariable
schema.Description: On a binder: 1 when its condition gives the variable a finite range (as in Theorem C's t in [T, 2T + p]).

schema.name: IntroducedInLoop
schema.Description: The model-native loop that added this term; empty for the core predicates.

schema.name: PredicateKey
schema.Description: The predicate whose statement this node belongs to (a plain key, not a reference: Predicates already points at the root term).

schema.name: OpKind
schema.Description: How the term is written out.

schema.name: OpIsModeled
schema.Description: 1 when the model computes the operator.

schema.name: VarUnbounded
schema.Description: 1 when the variable ranges over an infinite domain.

schema.name: Rendered
schema.Description: The term written out in Wolfram Language style, computed from the tree.

schema.name: IsUnboundedBinder
schema.Description: 1 for a quantifier over an infinite domain.

schema.name: IsUnmodeledOperator
schema.Description: 1 when the model does not compute this operator yet.

Predicates.Description: The properties stated about the model: definitions, theorems, bridge obligations and the three prize problems. The formal statement is a Terms tree; its bounded instances are computed from the model; a model-native loop adds its hypotheses here as rows.

schema.name: Problem
schema.Description: Definition, Known result, Theorem, Bridge obligation, Hypothesis, or the prize problem it is (P1, P2, P3).

schema.name: InstanceKind
schema.Description: Which reference of PredicateInstances decides an instance.

schema.name: Statement
schema.Description: A gloss in words; the formal content is the term tree.

schema.name: FailureRefutes
schema.Description: 1 when a failing instance is a counterexample to the statement; 0 when it only means the horizon did not decide it.

schema.name: BoundSlope
schema.Description: For bound hypotheses: the bound is slope * |a| + intercept.

schema.name: DomainMin
schema.Description: For bound hypotheses: the smallest index (N, T) the statement covers.

schema.name: CoversDomain
schema.Description: 1 when the instance rows enumerate the whole bounded domain of the statement, so holding on all of them verifies it; 0 when they are a sample (a model horizon shorter than the statement).

schema.name: IntroducedInLoop
schema.Description: The model-native loop that stated this predicate; empty for the core predicates.

schema.name: Formal
schema.Description: The formal statement, written out from its term tree.

schema.name: UnmodeledOperatorCount
schema.Description: Operators of the statement the model does not compute yet.

schema.name: IsComputable
schema.Description: 1 when every operator of the statement has a meaning in the model.

schema.name: IsFinitelyDecidable
schema.Description: 1 when the model can decide the full statement, not only bounded instances.

schema.name: RowCount
schema.Description: Instance rows, in or out of the domain.

schema.name: InstanceCount
schema.Description: Bounded instances in the domain of the statement.

schema.name: IsRefuted
schema.Description: 1 when a counterexample instance fails: the statement is false.

schema.name: IsVerified
schema.Description: 1 when the statement is finite, its instances cover its domain and every one holds: the model decides it true.

schema.name: FiniteVerdict
schema.Description: What the model says about the bounded instances.
schema.formula: =IF({{InstanceCount}}=0,"NO INSTANCES",IF({{FailingCount}}=0,"HOLDS ON EVERY INSTANCE",IF({{FailureRefutes}}=1,CONCAT("REFUTED BY ",{{FailingCount}}," OF ",{{InstanceCount}}," INSTANCES"),CONCAT({{FailingCount}}," OF ",{{InstanceCount}}," UNDECIDED AT THE HORIZON"))))

PredicateInstances.Description: One bounded instance of a predicate, pointing at the model row that decides it. This is the roof all predicates share: whether an instance is in the domain, whether it holds and its witness are all read from the model.

schema.name: IntroducedInLoop
schema.Description: The model-native loop that added this instance; empty for the core predicates.

schema.name: RuleTableEntry
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a RuleTableEntry instance.

schema.name: Run
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a Run instance.

schema.name: PeriodTest
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a PeriodTest instance.

schema.name: PeriodicityCandidate
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a PeriodicityCandidate instance.

schema.name: MismatchWindow
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a MismatchWindow instance.

schema.name: Cell
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a Cell instance.

schema.name: LeftConsistencyCheck
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a LeftConsistencyCheck instance.

schema.name: TailCandidate
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a TailCandidate instance.

schema.name: DiagonalPeriodTest
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a DiagonalPeriodTest instance.

schema.name: DiagonalFact
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a DiagonalFact instance.

schema.name: AcceleratorClaim
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a AcceleratorClaim instance.

schema.name: Tolerance
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a Tolerance instance.

schema.name: Algorithm
schema.Description: Deciding row, for a Algorithm instance.

schema.name: CandidateWitness
schema.Description: First mismatch at or after the onset.

schema.name: CellDiscrepancy
schema.Description: Ones minus zeros of the prefix.

schema.name: FactIsDecided
schema.Description: The horizon certifies what the fact needs.

schema.name: InDomain
schema.Description: 1 when the instance lies in the domain the statement quantifies over (computed, not chosen).

schema.name: Holds
schema.Description: 1 when the instance holds, read from its deciding row.

schema.name: Witness
schema.Description: The time step that decides it, where there is one: the refuting mismatch or the kill.

AcceleratorClaims.Description: A value an optimizer outside the rulebook claims for a cell. The rulebook computes the cell itself and decides whether the claim matches.

schema.name: Cell
schema.Description: The cell the claim is about.

schema.name: Source
schema.Description: The evidence file the claimed value comes from.

schema.name: ModelValue
schema.Description: The value the model computes for that cell.

schema.name: IsMatch
schema.Description: 1 when the optimizer agrees with the model.
